question: 促销期净销额占总净销额的比例是多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN fs.is_promo THEN fs.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS promo_net,
    SUM(fs.net_amount) AS total_net
  FROM fact_sales fs
  JOIN dim_date d ON fs.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
  promo_net / NULLIF(total_net, 0) AS 促销期净销额占比
FROM s

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
WITH brand_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.brand,
    SUM(s.net_amount) AS brand_net_amount
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY p.brand
),
total_sales AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS total_net_amount
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
)
SELECT 
  bs.brand AS 品牌
FROM brand_sales bs
CROSS JOIN total_sales ts
WHERE bs.brand_net_amount / NULLIF(ts.total_net_amount, 0) > 0.10

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
WITH outlet_net AS (
    SELECT 
        s.outlet_id,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS outlet_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
),
avg_net AS (
    SELECT AVG(outlet_net_amount) AS avg_net_amount
    FROM outlet_net
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS 净销额高于平均水平的终端数
FROM outlet_net
WHERE outlet_net_amount > (SELECT avg_net_amount FROM avg_net)

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    d.year_month,
    SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
  GROUP BY p.category, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
  a.category AS 品类
FROM monthly_sales a
JOIN monthly_sales b 
  ON a.category = b.category 
  AND a.year_month = '2026-08' 
  AND b.year_month = '2026-07'
WHERE a.total_qty > b.total_qty

ranked AS (

    SUM(净销额) OVER (ORDER BY 净销额 DESC) AS 累计净销额,

    dl.dealer_name,
    SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost_amount
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_dealer dl ON pc.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
  WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY dl.dealer_id, dl.dealer_name
)
SELECT
  s.dealer_name,
  s.promo_net_amount / NULLIF(c.cost_amount, 0) AS 费效比
FROM s
JOIN c ON s.dealer_id = c.dealer_id
ORDER BY 费效比 DESC
LIMIT 5

question: 2026年8月库存周转天数最长的十个经销商
sql:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT 
    dl.dealer_id,
    dl.dealer_name,
    SUM(fi.qty_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
  FROM fact_inventory fi
  JOIN dim_date d ON fi.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_dealer dl ON fi.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
  WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY dl.dealer_id, dl.dealer_name
),
sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.dealer_id,
    SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.date_key) AS days
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY s.dealer_id
)
SELECT 
  inv.dealer_name,
  inv.total_qty_on_hand / NULLIF(sales.total_qty / NULLIF(sales.days, 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM inv
JOIN sales ON inv.dealer_id = sales.dealer_id
ORDER BY 库存周转天数 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 各大区的新品铺市率是多少
sql:
WITH new_product_outlets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.region, r.outlet_id
  FROM rel_outlet_sku r
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON r.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON r.sku_id = p.sku_id
  WHERE p.is_new_product = TRUE
    AND r.delisted_date IS NULL
    AND o.is_active = TRUE
),
total_outlets AS (
  SELECT region, COUNT(DISTINCT outlet_id) AS total_cnt
  FROM dim_outlet
  WHERE is_active = TRUE
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  o.region AS 大区,
  COUNT(DISTINCT n.outlet_id)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0) AS 新品铺市率
FROM dim_outlet o
LEFT JOIN new_product_outlets n ON o.region = n.region AND o.outlet_id = n.outlet_id
JOIN total_outlets t ON o.region = t.region
WHERE o.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY o.region, t.total_cnt
ORDER BY o.region

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
  SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_amount
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY o.region
),
previous_period AS (
  SELECT 
    o.region,
    SUM(s.net_amount) AS previous_net_amount
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
  GROUP BY o.region
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(c.region, p.region) AS 大区,
  (c.current_net_amount - p.previous_net_amount) / NULLIF(p.previous_net_amount, 0) AS 同比增长率
FROM current_period c
FULL JOIN previous_period p ON c.region = p.region
ORDER BY 大区

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
  SELECT 
    o.channel,
    SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS current_output
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
  GROUP BY o.channel
),
last_year_period AS (
  SELECT 
    o.channel,
    SUM(s.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id), 0) AS last_year_output
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
  WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
  GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(c.channel, l.channel) AS 渠道,
  c.current_output - l.last_year_output AS 单店产出变化
FROM current_period c
FULL JOIN last_year_period l ON c.channel = l.channel
ORDER BY 单店产出变化 DESC

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) FILTER (WHERE s.is_promo) AS promo_amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.year_month
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY d.year_month
),
combined AS (
  SELECT s.year_month, s.promo_amt, c.cost
  FROM s
  JOIN c ON s.year_month = c.year_month
),
periods AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN year_month >= '2025-07' AND year_month <= '2025-12' THEN '2025H2'
         WHEN year_month >= '2026-01' AND year_month <= '2026-06' THEN '2026H1'
    END AS period,
    SUM(promo_amt) AS promo_amt,
    SUM(cost) AS cost
  FROM combined
  WHERE year_month >= '2025-07' AND year_month <= '2026-06'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN promo_amt / NULLIF(cost, 0) END) -
   SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN promo_amt / NULLIF(cost, 0) END)) AS 费效比提升
FROM periods
